instruction: Duplicate the badge image in the top right corner of the first slide and set the copy next to the original image.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires duplicating the badge image on the top right of slide 1 and placing the copy next to the original. The evaluator: (1) extracts all image positions and dimensions, (2) identifies the top-right badge by position, (3) verifies a duplicate exists with same dimensions, (4) confirms the duplicate is placed next to the original (within 1.5x image width/height proximity), and (5) ensures image count is 5 (was 4 before duplication).

Getter extracts the correct state: all image positions and dimensions from slide 0 using python-pptx library
Metric logic is semantically sound: compares dimensions with appropriate tolerance, checks spatial proximity using center-to-center distance, and ensures proper separation
